name: SteamCacheBundle
description: SteamcacheBundle provides DNS entries for *.cs.steampowered.com and other download URLs and has GenericCache server and SNIProxy in the built in. Please see https://squishedmooo.com/the-new-and-easier-all-in-one-steamcache/ for install instructions! You will need them! To see accesslogs type "tail -f /data/logs/access.log" (Without quotes) in the docker console. Big Thanks to cheesemarathon for all the help! If you want to use Unraid's IP download his, containers.

paths.name: data
paths.description: Location to store the cached files

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Location to store the cache logs

ports.description: Container Port: 443 SNIProxy port, don't change!

variables.name: LANCACHE_IP
variables.description: IP Address of cache container. (Has to be the same as the HOST's IP. If you set the container's IP to 192.168.1.108 this has to be the same. If you use bridge it has to be the same as unRAID's IP.)

variables.name: CACHE_MAX_AGE
variables.description: Max age for files in the cache

variables.name: USE_GENERIC_CACHE
variables.description: Must be set to true to use generic cache

variables.name: DISABLE_FRONTIER
variables.description: Set to true to disable frontier caching

variables.name: DISABLE_ORIGIN
variables.description: Set to true to disable origin caching

variables.name: DISABLE_RIOT
variables.description: Set to true to disable riot caching

variables.name: DISABLE_STEAM
variables.description: Set to true to disable steam caching

variables.name: DISABLE_UPLAY
variables.description: Set to true to disable uplay caching

variables.name: DISABLE_BLIZZARD
variables.description: Set to true to disable blizzard caching

variables.name: DISABLE_WINDOWS
variables.description: Set to true to disable windows update caching
